mapper.insert: insert into replacement_records (house_id, rabbit_id, request_id, original_type, replacement_date, expected_mature_date, is_mature_notified, mature_notify_date, status, promoted_at, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{rabbitId}, #{requestId}, #{originalType}, #{replacementDate}, #{expectedMatureDate}, #{isMatureNotified}, #{matureNotifyDate}, #{status}, #{promotedAt}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select * from replacement_records where house_id = #{houseId} and request_id = #{requestId} order by rabbit_id, id
select * from replacement_records where house_id = #{houseId} and expected_mature_date <= #{today} and is_mature_notified = false and status = 'PENDING' order by expected_mature_date asc, id asc
mapper.update: update replacement_records set is_mature_notified = true, mature_notify_date = #{notifyDate}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and house_id = #{houseId}
mapper.select: select * from replacement_records where house_id = #{houseId} and rabbit_id = #{rabbitId} and status = 'PENDING' order by id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update replacement_records set status = 'PROMOTED', promoted_at = #{promotedAt}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
